entries.title: 🤝 Your word to {client}
entries.text: A month after the dinner, the promise is still the quiet third party in every phone call with {client}. A word in time now costs little — and buys patience for the stretch ahead.

quest.title: Your word to {client}
quest.step: Keep the promise to {client} on track

choices.label: Give an honest progress report

effects.text: You keep {client} in the loop on your promise — patience secured.

choices.outcome: You lay out what has moved and what has not. {client} appreciates being treated like a partner, not a deadline.

effects_fail.text: Your progress report on the {client} promise lands wobbly.

choices.outcome_fail: The report sounds thinner out loud than it did in your head. {client} hears the gaps.

choices.label: Say nothing — let the work speak later
choices.outcome: Silence is a bet that the delivery will be loud enough. The clock keeps its own counsel.

entries.title: 🤝 The promise to {client}: crunch time
entries.text: The window on your word to {client} is narrowing. Whatever happens next happens on the record — kept promises build careers here, broken ones build reputations.

quest.step: The clock on your promise to {client} is running down

choices.label: Double down: clear the decks for it

effects.text: You clear the decks for the {client} promise — whatever it takes.

choices.outcome: Calendars are rearranged, favors warmed up. The promise gets your best hours now.

choices.label: Prepare {client} for the possibility of failure

effects.text: You level with {client} about the promise. Bitter, but honest.

choices.outcome: A hard conversation ahead of the deadline hurts less than silence after it. {client} takes it — barely.
